Run directories (`.amby/fleet/<run>/`) written by the **v1.6.0 build** (feature 033, US-6, FR-012), generated by running 028's own
interrupt and conflict scenarios against the tagged release with its fake assistants, and copied here unchanged (this machine's temp
path would have been replaced by `<root>`; none appeared).

- `interrupted-mid-run/`: two lanes started, lane 1-1 had checked T001 off, then the run was interrupted (`paused`, lanes queued).
- `interrupted-mid-merge/`: lane 1-1 merged, lane 1-2 hit a merge conflict (`conflict`, run `waiting-person`).

`test/cli/run-resume-1.6.test.ts` puts each directory into a project in the same git state and continues the run with the 2.x core.
